stories.title: Jeffery Simmons makes smashing Bears debut in rout of Seahawks
stories.summary: Caleb Williams and Jeffery Simmons had the Bears controlling both sides of the ball on MNF.

stories.title: In sign of good times, LeBron takes sip of fan's wine as 76ers roll on
stories.summary: LeBron James took a sip of a fan's wine during the 76ers 126-107 win over the Bulls, saying he wanted to try "how good it was."

stories.title: Luka stays hot with 42, earns high praise from Giannis that 'some people are scared to say'
stories.summary: Luka Doncic's volcanic scoring spree continued Monday with 42 points in the Lakers' 138-117 win over the Heat, prompting Giannis Antetokounmpo to call him "one of the best scorers to play this game" -- "of all time."

stories.title: Draymond ejected after scuffle with Brooks, Suns; Curry says it 'lit a fire' in Warriors
stories.summary: Draymond Green was ejected for the first time this season -- and 31st time of his career -- after receiving two technical fouls in the same sequence vs. the Suns.

stories.title: Cardinals name Minshew as starter, move Brissett to QB3
stories.summary: The Cardinals named Gardner Minshew as the team's new starting QB while moving Jacoby Brissett below rookie Carson Beck on the depth chart.
